Definitions.-(l) In these rules, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,- (a) (Act" means the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan Act,2012 (XXII of 2012); (b) "appellate authoritY" means a person to whom appeal lies under these rules; (e) (c) ,,appointing authority" means a person or an authority authorized by these rules to make appointment to a posU (d) ,,authority" means the appointing authority prescribed in these rules and competent to impose penalty on an employee; ,,authorized officer" means an officer appointed by the authority to perform functions of an authorized officer in disciplinary cases under these rules and where no such authorized officer is appointed, the authority;' "competent authority" means the Director General, or any other officei who perform tire functions in the organization on the behalf of the Director General; "departmental promotion committee" means a Committee .onititut"d for the purpose of making selection for promotion cases of regular employees of the organization; "departmental selection committee" means a committee consiituted by the Board for initial appointment; ,,deputationist" means a person who is appointed for a specific perioa by the organization on such terms and conditions mutually agreed upon by ihe Organization and the lending department in aicordance with the Federal Govemment rules "IPO Pakistan" means Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan; ,,Ip Pay Scales,, includes the Intellectual Property Management (lPM) and Intellectual Property Staff (IPS), pay scales ; and "penalty" means a penalty specified under Civil Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 2020. CHAPTER II . APPOINTMENT, PROMOTION, P_OSTING, TRANSFER AND SENIORITY 3. Human Resource of the organization.-{r) The human resource of the Organizationshall include the following, namely:_ ' (a) employees of the organization; (b) civil servants absorbed in the organization under the Act; (c) deputationists; and (d) contractemployees. (2) The civil servants working in the Organization shall be entitled to such benefits, as admissible under these rules. (3) The cadre-wise seniority in respect of the employees of Ipo Pakistan-Ilead office, Registries, offices shall be maintained ut it.ipo p"r.iri* head Office, Islamabad separately. 4. Method of Appointment.-Appointment to a post shail be made by one or more of the following methods, namely:_ (a) by initial appointment; or . (b) by promotion; or (c) by transfer; or (d) by contract. 5. Designation of posts and pay scare r.- The designation of existing posts in the organization and theii appointment criteria shall be as follows, namely:- , (a) the organization may with prior approvar of the Board, re-designate the existing posts, from time to time, keeping in view the scof,e of work; ( THE GAZETTE OF PAKISTAN, EXTRA. SEPTEMBER 2022 3797 (b) the Organization shall submit cases for creation of posts to the Finance Division with the prior approval of the Board. These posts shall be reflected in the annual budget ofthe organization; and (c) the designation, re-design4tion, and appointment criteria of existing and reserved posts for the organization shall be as per Schedule-I to IV. For the purpose of these rules, the reserved post means the posts reserved for the posting and promotion of the Commerce and Trade Group. 6. Initial Appointment.{l) No person shall be appointed to a post through initial appointment unless such person possesses the qualifications, postqualification experience and is within the age-limit as specified in the Schedule against that post. (2) Maximum age limit for initial appointment against sanctioned posts shall be admissible as provided in schedule-I to IV. (3) The recommendation for initial appointment made by the Departmental Selection Committee may be based on assessment of the candidate in written test and interview: Provided that the Departmental Selection Committee shall recommend to the Board for approval, the method of appointment for initial appointment for any particular post in view of requirements of the Organization at the time of advertisement. (4) All initial appointments in the Organization against sanctioned posts in each pay scale shall be made in accordance with merit and Provincial or iegional quotas or other quotas prescribed by the Govemment from time to time. (5) The vacancies in posts IPS-IV which serve only a particular Province or region shall preferably be filled by appointment of persons domiciled in the Province or region concerned. Vacancies in IPS-IV preferably be filled from the local candidates ofthe area. (6) The domicile and date of birth of an employee as declared by him and accepted by the Organization at the time of his first entry in servipe shall be treated as final throughout his service and no subsequent change shall be recognized for the purpose of terms and conditions of his service. (7) Every person, shall be required, before his appointment to furnish a written declaration to the effect that he has not previously been convicted by a Court of Law for an offence involving moral turpitude, or dismissed from service of the Federal or a Provincial Govemment or a body managed or controlled by the Federal or Provincial Government. Panr III 3797 (64) THE GAZETTE OF PAKISTAN , EXTRA., SEPTEMBER 3,2022 [pARr II (8) All sanctioned posts reserved for direct recruitment and contract appointments shall be advertised in the newspapers. (9) A candidate for initial appointment must be in good mental and physical health and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with the discharge of his duties except for appointment against disabled quota. (10) A candidate appointed as a result of process in rule 7, shall be referred within ten days ofjoining, to a Government hospital or hospital on panel of the Organization, for a medical examination. The candidate shall submit the duly certified Medical Fitness Certificate by the designated Medical Officer to the Human Resource wing of the Organization (11) The prospective employee shall have to provide at least two references, giving confirmation of the sound moral characier of the prospective employee, from persons who are either already employed at a responsible position in any Federal, Provincial or local Government oi attached department. The Organization may at its discretion, ask for the comments from the referred persons regarding the concerned employee. In addition to above, qualification certificates and degrees are also required to be verified. 7. Appointment by promotion.{l) The Departmental promotion committee as constituted by the Board as amended from lime to time, shall be .responsible for the promotion of the employees. promotion from one post to next higher post or to any particular post shall be considered on the basii of criteria laid down in these rules and auached Schedule I-lV including length of service, seniority, competence and annual performance evaluation ."po.tr. (2) Any employee, otherwise eligible for promotion, may be considered for acting charge basis. 8. Appointment by Deputation.-A person in the service of Federal Government or Provincial Govemment or an autonomous, semi-autonomous body or corporation or any other organization set-up, established owned, managed or controlled by the Federal or provincial Govemment who porr"rr"i relevant experience or comparable length ofservice prescribed for a post shall be eligible for appointment to the said post on deputation for initial p.iiod of three years, extendable for another period of two years on such terms and conditionS as agreed between the lbnding and borrowing Organizations. 9. contract appointment.-The organization may, with the approval of the Board, may appoint a person on contract basis. 10. Absorption of contract or Daily-wage employees.-All regular appointments and absorptions shall be made through I competiiive process. ! PARTIf TTmGAZETTEOF 11. Obligation to serve on any post-Al employee of the Organization shall be obliged to serve against any post equivalent or higher to his scale at my place, controlled or managed by the Organization as per Establishment Division policy. 12. Authority competent to make postings and transfers.-Under the provisions ofsub-section (2) ofsection 24 ofthe Act and as per policy ofthe Federal Government from time to time. The Director General shall make postings and transfers of all employees within the Organization, as deemed appropriate, for proper and efficient working of the Organization. 13. Additional charge of an equivalent post{l) Where considered necessary in the interest of the Organization and to carry out day to day work of a vacant post, an employee maybe given the additional charge of the vacant post till such time as determined by'the Competent authority and permissible under these rules subject to the approval of the Finance Division. (2) An additional charge allowance may be given as per policy of the Federal Government from time to time. 14. Current charge of a higher post.{1) Where considered essential in the interest of the Organization, the competent authority in accordance with guidelines of the Federal Government from time to time. (2) Such an employee shall be entitled to other facilities, as per policy of the Federal Government. 15. Seniority.-For proper administration, the Organization shall prepare cadre-wise seniority list of the employees, working in the Organization and occupying sanctioned posts in accordance with the Civil Servants Seniority Rules. 1993 as amended from time to time. CHAPTER III PROBATION, TERMINATION, CONFIRMATION, RESIGNATION AND RETIREMENT 16. Probation.-{1) A person appointed by initial recruitment or by promotion in the Organization shall be placed on probation for a period of one (01) year. (2) On successfi.rl completion of the probation period, the Appointing Authority may, by specific order, terminate the probation and the employee shall become a regular employee of the Organization. 3797 (66) Trm GAZETTE OF PAKISTAN, EXTRA., SEPTEMBER 3,2022 [PARr II (3) Ifno order is issued under sub-rule (2) above, on the expiry ofthe first year of probation period, the period of probation shall be deemed to have been extended for another one year or till issuance ofsuch order. 11. Termination during probation.{1) Where, in the opinion of the competent authority, conduct or performance of an employee on probation has not been satisfactory or his character or antecedents are not found satisfactory, his service may be terminated by the competent authority in accordance wiih Section II of Civil Servants Act,1973 (LXXI of 1973). (2) A person appointed in the Organization on contract may be terminated by the Appointing Authority in accordance with the terms & conditions of the appointment letter as per the FG rules and regulations. 18. Confirmation.-{l) A person appointed against a sanctioned post shall, on successful completion ofprobation ot extended period ofprobation, be confirmed by the appointing authority in the respective cadre in the Organization. (2) A person against whom disciplinary proceedings are pending shall not be confirmed till finalization of the proceedings. 19. Resignation.-{1) A permanent or temporary employee of the Organization, who wishes to terminate his appointment should submit his resignation in writing. The resignation should not become effective unless it is accepted by the competent authority. Till such time the resignation is accepted, the employee concerned continues to be in service and cannot absent himself from duties without proper leave or on terms and conditions of contract. (2) Acceptance of resigaation by the competent authority shall be subject to recovery ofall outstanding dues. (3) In case an employee withdraws his resignation before it is accepted by the competent authority, the resignation shall be deemed to have been withdrawn. However, the option to withdraw the resignation shall be available only once in entire service. The Competent authority, however, may allow withdrawal of resignation after its acceptance, but before the effective date of resignation or relieving. (4) It shall be at the discretion of the competent authority to either accept or reject the resignation tendered by an employee during pendency of disciplinary proceeding against him, provided that acceptance of resignation in such cases shall be exercised with due diligence and caution. 20. Retirement.-{l) A regular employee of the organization shall retire from the service upon attaining the age ofsuperannuation. PART THE GAZETTE OF PAKISTAN, EXTRA., StsPTEMBER 3,2022 3797 (2) An employee, after completion of twenty five years of service, before attaining the age of superannuation, may apply for Leave Preparatory to Retirement (LPR), or encashment in lieu of LPR, if the employee undertakes in writing to perform duty in lieu of the maximum period of three hundred and sixty five days or lesser period which is due and admissible. The employee shall stand retired from the service of the organization on expiry of LPR or encashment in lieu of LPR or attaining the age of60, as thp case may be. (3) The Competent authority may approve LPR or encashment in lieu of LPR in respect of the employee of the Organization 21. Procedure for withdrawal of LPR.-Withdrawal of LPR shall be treated as pei Federal Govemment rules as amended from time to time. CHAPTER V JOINING TIME, LEAVE AND TRAINING 22. Joining time.-Joining time shall be granted to an employee to enable him to join ilost to which he is appointed, transferred, or promoted while on duty at another station in the Organization. The joining time of the employee of the Organization shall be regulated under the Federal Government Rules and instructions of the Financb Division, issued from time to time, 23. Leave.-Subject to the provisions of rule 29, the Revised Leave Rules, 1980, as amended from time to time, shall be mutatis mutandis applicable to the employees of the organization. 24. In-Service death.-If an employee of the Organization dies while in service, the family of the deceased employee shall be entitled to financial assistance as.per the Federal Govemment policy, 26. Training.-The competent authority may ih the public interest require an employee of the Organization working in any grade or pay scale, to undergo such training within or outside Pakistan at any time and for any duration and on such terms and conditions as they may specifu in each case. 27. Surrender.--The competent authority may surrender the services of a deputationist or an offrcer working against post in the organizatioq if his services are no more required. 28. Repatriation.-The competent authority, may repatriate officers or officials on deputation to their parent departments or Divisions on completion of deputation period. 29. Gifts.-For the purpose of the gifts Cabinet Division instructions shall be followed as amended from time to time. CHAPTER _ VI EFFICIENCY AND DISCIPLINE 30. Efficiency and discipline.-For the purpose of efficiency and discipline, the employee of the organization shall be govemed under the Government Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 2020, as amended from time to time. The provisions of Civil Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 2020, ihall mutatis mutandis apply. 31. Departmental appeal, review and representation.-For the purpose of the Departmental appeal, review and repreSentation, employees of the organization shall be governed under the Civil Servants Appeal Rules, 1977, as amended from time to time. The provisions of Civil Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 2020, shall mutatis mutandis apply. CHAPTER - VII PAY AND ALLOWANCES 33. Pay scales.-(l) The scheme of the Basic Pay Scales of the Federal Government shail be applicable to the employees of the organization who opted for such Basic Pay Scales with approval of the Board. The option once exercised by employees shall be irrevocable. (2) The pay and allowances of civil servants who have been absorbed in the organization and opted to remain civil servants shall be entitled to draw pay, allowances and fringe benefits as per the rates of the Federal Government from time to time. The deputationists in the organization shall be governed by the terms and conditions of their service as agreed betrveen the lending and borrowing organization or department. (3) The pay and allowance of the employees of the organization working against IP Scales shall be admissible as per Schedule-Il-E, determined by the Board from time to time subject to the concurrence of the Finance Division. (4) The pay and allowances of the contract employees of the organization shall be admissible in accordance with terms and conditions of their contract employment as per the approval of the Policy Board. (5) Thb pay of employee on initial appointment shall be fixed at the minimum stage of the respective scale. 3797 (70) Trm GAZETTE OF PAKISTAN, EXTRA., SEPTEMBER 3,2022 [Penr II 34. Additional allowances.-The employees, including civil servants who were absorbed in the Organization and opted to remain as civil servants, deputationists shall be entitled to draw additional allowances, facilities and other benefis as per Schedule-Vl, as revised by the Board from time to time 35. Overtime Allowance.{1) Overtime allowance shall be admissible to all employees of the organization as approved by the Board and revised from time to time. (2) In case of officers in IPS-I/BS-16 and above, who perform officiar duties beyond normal office timings, shall be entitled to claim taxi charges, if no official vehicle is provided. 36. Payment of salary and allowances to the Director General.- The Director General shall be entitled to draw pay, allowances, privileges and other facilities of his own pa.y scale in addition to the allowances i. permissible under the Federal Government Rules. Any bdditional allowance or benefit shall be subject to the concurrence of the Finanie Division after approval of the B"r;J. 37. House Rent Allowance.-Employees of the organization shall be entitled to draw house rent allowance at rates specified in schedule-vl, as approved by the Board. Employees who opted to remain civil servants shall be allowed HRA at the rate allowed to the Federal Government employees. 38. Hired accommodation facility to employees of the organization.- In case an employee of the Organization, including deputationists, intends to hire residential accommodation,.whether self or privately hired, he may submit an application along with requisite documents for hiring and for fufther processing and approval of the competent authority. 39. Rates of rental ceilings for the employees.-The rates of rented accommodation for the employees of the Organization, deputationists and Civil Servants, shall be the same as approved by the Finance Division and revised from time to time in the corresponding pay scales or equivalent pay scale. 40. Inspection committee for hiring.{l) An Inspection committee shall be constituted by the organization, from time to time, for the purposes of inspection and assessment of accommodation relatod matters. on the basis of recommendations of the Committee, a formal sanction for payment shall be issued with the approval of the competent authority on case to case basis. (2) The Inspection committee for the Head office and each Registry or office shall be notified separately from tirne to time. 3 PARr lll THE GAZETTE OF PAKISTAN, EXTRA., SEPTEMBER 3,2022 3797 (71) CHAPTER. VIII TRAVELLING 41. circumstance in which travelling expenses shall be admissible.- Travelling expenses shall be admissible to an employee of the Organization for travelling on duty, on official tour, on transfer or retirement. Prior approval of the competent authoiity shall be required before undertaking the journey. ln specific cases where prior approval is not possible within reasonable means of the employee or may result in any delay or adverse impabt on the discharge of funitions, the competent authority may allow verbal approval and confirm the approval after the travel. After the conclusion of an authorized joumey, the diiails of expenses shall be submitted by the employee concemed within one month from ihe date of approval of the competent authority for adjustment of accounts. If details of expenses are not submitted within stipulated period of thirty days due to an unavoidable circumstance, the delay involved may be .ondon.d by the Director General or the Chairman. The guidelines contained in the booklet titled "A Manual on Travelling Allowance Rules" as amended from ,time to time, published by the Pakistan Public Administration Research Centre shall be followed. 42. Entitlement for different categories of employees.-For the purposes of calculating travelling allowance, the employees of the Organization have been divided into the following categories namely: 43. Fare entitlement.-For journey performed on official tour or temporary transfer, an employee shall be entitled to a single fare' 44. Rates of daily allowance for employees.-The rates of daily allowances for employees of the Organization shall be allowed, as per Government prescribed rates, applicable from time to time, for its employees in equivalent or colresponding Basic Scale. Rates of daily allowance for foreign travel including transit- Rates of daily allowance for foreign travel including transit shall be allowed as approved by the Fedeial Government from time to time for its employees in equivalent Basic Scale. 46. Travelling allowance policy.-The traveling allowance shall be granted to an employee as per policy of the Federal Government. 47. Allowance for road journey.{l) Employees of the organization shall be entitled to road journey allowance as admissible to the Federal Government Employees. (2) The employees in IPM-IV/BS- 17 and, above, subject to the prior approval of the competent authority shall be entitled to travel.in their own car or hire a taxi, if official transport is not provided or the use of official transport is not permissible beyond the municipal limits of the relevant station under prevalent laws or the use of official transport is not deemed economical. 48. Claim for hiring of taxi in emergency.-If in case of an emergency, an employee has to reach at a particular point immediately, and when other means of transpoft are not available, he may hire a taxi and claim reimbursement on the certificate of the controlling authority that hiring of a taxi was necessary to complete an assigrment given to the employee. 49. General conditions.-Reimbursement of conveyance or taxi charges shall be made as actually paid by the employee. Employee in IpS-IV or BS-5 and below shall avail the Bus or wagon service plying at an outstation and claim conveyance expense accordingly. In emergency, when it is necessary to reach at a point immediately and when other means of conveyance are not available, competent authority may allow hiring of a taxi. 50. Daily allowance not admissible within municipal limits.-Daily allowance shall not be admissible to an employee for travelling within thl Municipal limits of the station in which his headquarter is situated. 51. Daily allowance during lialt or hotiday.-subject to the conditions laid down in these rules, daily allowance may be drawn during a halt while on official tour or on a holiday occurring during an official tciur. 52. Daily allowance and its calculation.{l) A dairy allowance is a uniform allowance for each day out of station while on ofniiat duty that is intended to cover the extra daily. expenditure incurred by an empioyee in consequence of such absence. (2) A day is to be reckoned from midnight. PART II] THE GAZETTE OF PAKISTAN, EXTRA., SEPTEMBER 3,2022 3797 (73) (3) Daily allowance shall be admissible at full rate when during the absence from the office, a night is spent while being on tour. (4) Daily allowance will be admissible at half rate when the absence from the office is more than 4 hours but no night intervenes the said absence. (5) A part ofday less than four hours is to be ignored for the purposes of daily allowance. 53. Forced delays in transit period.-The period of forced delays in transit shall be treated as total transit period' 54. Road mileage journey allowance.-. Road mileage joumey allowance between railway station or airport and the place of residence or temporary residence at the outstation shall also be admissible, provided that .ofniiat tianspon is not provided for the purpose or if provided to an offtcer in ipVt-tV or BS-17 and above, it is under repair and not road worthy. 55. Journey by personal car.-An employee in-IPM-IV/BS-17 and above may be allowed to perform joumey by road in pdrsonal car between places connected by rail or air, with the prior approval of the competent authority. 56. Period admissible for daily allowance.-Daily allowance at full rate shall be admissible for the entire period of continuous halt on temporary duty, without any reduction in rate' 57. Admissibility of daily allowance during casual leave.-If casual leave is taken immediately on the conclusion of the temporary duty, daily allowance shall be admissible for the day of departure from the out-statiorU ht the same rate as would have been allowed if casual leave was not taken. 58. Travelling allowance for journeys on transfer.-on transfer, the transfer grant shall be admissible to an employee of the Organization and his family as per Federal Govemment rates. 59. Travelling allowance for journey on retirement.-Travelling Allowance on retirement shall be admissible to an employee as per Federal Government Rules. 60. Controlling authority.-Bills for travelling expense shall be approved and countersigred by such persons as may be designated for the pu.pose by the competent authority, from time to time' 61. No travelling allowance on first appointment.-No travelling allowance shall be paid to a person upon joining his first appointment in the Organization. 3797 (74) THE GAZETTE OF PAKISTAN , EXTRA., SEPTEMBER 3,2022 [PART II 62. Concessional fare to be availed.-{oncessional fare to be availed shall be admissible as per Federal Government policy and Rules. 63. Travelling allowance for a journey not provided for in these rules.Jn case a journey is taken by an employee for which no provision is made in these rules such as by a ship, travelling allowance shall be paid on such scale as may be determined on a case to case basis in consultation with Finance Division. ' 64. Travelling allowance not to be a source of profit.-As a general rule, travelling allowance paid to an employee is intendei to cover thJactual travelling expenses and is not to be treated as a source of profit or income. 65. Reimbursement of cancellation expenses.-Reimbursement of expenses incurred on account of cancellation of reserved seat may be allowed if the-cancellation was due to the eleventh hour change in the tour p.ogrurn due to unavoidable reasons or on account of direction from the organizatioi, subject to the productiOn of cancellation voucher. CHAPTER - IX MISCELLANEOUS 66. Relaxation in age.-Relaxation in upper age limit shall be admissible as per the Federar Government rures, only orice, under special circumstances, where needed. 67. Removal of difficulties.-If any difficulty arises in giving effect to any provision of these rules, the Board may make such orler fot being inconsistent with the provisions of the Act as may appear to it to be necessary for the purposes of removing difficulties. 68. Absence of piovision in the rules.-where these rules and the Act are silent in respect of any terms and conditions of an- employee of the organization or any matter relating to terms and conditions ol seivice of an employee of the Organization has not been provided for in the Act or these rules, the relevant rules and policy for Federal Government employees of corresponding level may apply. 69.
